concept_decisions: Concept resistant sill and parallel contact bands useful; excessive phototexture and repeated blocks not retained. Build integrated full-volume layered outcrop, shared dipping contacts, thick dark sill protruding beyond recessed host, shallow uneven physical joints in exposed sill face and several host bedding ledges. No individual intersecting blocks or random painted seam.
